740290101.text: Why have you got your fishing rod out over here? Are you really fishing?

740290102.text: There's water, and a rod... of course I'm fishing. To think that you outsiders don't even know that... What's this world coming to, seriously?

740290104.text: That's right! We're not complete amateurs at fishing either, y'know!

740290107.text: What Paimon meant to say is... Y'know, that it's kinda weird for a Melusine to be using a fishing rod. Paimon didn't think you fished like that.

740290108.text: I—I'm not being weird! I learned this from an outsider. Delaroche is a great person. She not only taught me how to fish, but she also gave me a rod too!

740290109.text: Hers looked nicer, of course, but that's fine — she's a "professional," and I'm just a "hobbyist."

740290110.text: Still... I've been waiting here for so long. Why haven't I gotten a bite yet?

740290111.text: Hehe, in that case, why don't you let us pros help you figure out where you're going wrong!

740290112.text: Huh? Are the two of you really better than Delaroche? She's a professional with a very pretty fishing rod...

740290113.text: Hmph! Looks like we might have to prove our skills, eh?

740290114.text: But are there actually any fish here?

740290115.text: Huh. Now that you mention it, there really aren't any! Paimon thought that was weird right from the get-go, too.

740290116.text: Fish... Delaroche did say that not all waters have fish in them. Um, does "that" count as a fish?

740290117.text: If "that" isn't a fish, could it be the reason I can't "fish" it up in the first place?

740290118.text: #Master {NICKNAME}, Master Paimon, please, tell me. What must I do to fish "that" up?

740290119.text: Um, you... sure are polite! Well, of course we'll help you — but first off, what's "that" thing you're referring to?

740290120.text: It moves very quickly in the water, and it's so slippery that it's really hard to catch.

740290106.text: That's true, you did fish Paimon out of the water back then, didn't you... Wait a minute, that's not the problem here!

740290201.text: ...Will it still be attracted to bait?

740290301.text: Iara places the weakened Ball Octopus into a waiting bucket...

740290302.text: What lovely fishing technique... But this creature is now no longer beautiful. How did this happen?

740290303.text: Sorry... We didn't think the "thing" you were talking about was a Ball Octopus, so we, err...

740290305.text: Yeah, you were way too hasty! Well, Paimon didn't stop you either...

740290308.text: Don't apologize. It is in the bucket now, and that's enough for me.

740290309.text: If you say so... But seriously, how did a Ball Octopus end up here? Did it follow the flow and then fall in by accident?

740290312.text: I wanted to be sure of my skills at using the fishing rod, which is why I went to go catch that... "Ball Octopus," I think you called it.

740290313.text: If I put it in here, I'd be able to fish it up whenever I wanted.

740290314.text: ...Or that was the plan, anyway. But I waited and waited, and it wouldn't bite no matter what.

740290315.text: It's kinda concerning how you captured one and put it in a pool to practice fishing with a rod...

740290316.text: But we just spread some bait out into the water, and it came out just like that. Didn't you think of doing something like that, Iara?

740290317.text: I tried many different types of bait, like minced meat, bread crumbs, worms, mints, components... It would just eat them and then disappear. I was even starting to think that bait had no effect on it!

740290318.text: Components!? That, err, doesn't sound like bait...

740290307.text: Yeah... When there's danger at hand, you've gotta strike first, y'know. But, well...

740299901.text: Iara places the weakened Ball Octopus into a waiting bucket...
